name: Andrzej Halicki - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text:
The European Parliament has set out what it wants the European Union's 2026 budget to pay for. It asks for more money for defence and security, research and small businesses, farmers and fishers, border protection, health, education and help for Ukraine. It also wants spending to protect the climate and nature, and simpler rules so money reaches people faster. This is Parliament's position, not a final budget: the actual spending plan is still to be negotiated with the Council and the Commission.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament states its spending priorities for 2026.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, researchers, small businesses, students, border regions and Ukraine.
- **What happens next:** Talks with the Council and Commission to agree the 2026 budget.
